away.summary: The Sabres are coming off a shootout loss to Montreal and will be without captain Rasmus Dahlin (upper-body, day to day) for the second straight game. Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen is confirmed to start in goal after earning the win in relief against Florida and starting Tuesday's loss to Montreal. Dennis Gilbert made his NHL season debut in the Canadiens game and is expected to remain in the lineup.

out.detail: upper-body injury, placed on injured reserve retroactive to Oct. 10

returning: detail: will play after missing practice Monday for maintenance
home.summary: The Maple Leafs are seeking back-to-back wins for the first time this season after a 6-3 road victory over Colorado. They will be missing key players Dakota Joshua (core), Max Domi (undisclosed), and Chris Tanev (upper-body, IR). Oliver Ekman-Larsson is expected to return to the lineup after a maintenance day. Anthony Stolarz is projected to start in goal, with Sergei Bobrovsky as the backup.
